name: code2flow-stories-from-prd
title_zh: PRD 改一版，故事地图跟着漂移一次
tagline_zh: PO 改需求最怕开发说「你上次不是这么说的」。把 PRD 变成 Code2Flow 故事清单，再对着代码图查漂移。
tagline_en: PO rewrites specs, devs say 'that's not what you said'. Turn PRD into Code2Flow stories, then diff against.
desc_en: Turn a PRD markdown into a Code2Flow Story Manifest (code2flow.stories.json v2) using the prompt pack produced by `code2flow stories scaffold`, then validate it against the scanned graph and report PRD-vs-code drift. Use when a PO wants user-story lanes on the Code2Flow canvas, or when a PRD changed.
why_zh: 不是单向翻译 PRD，而是拿扫描出的真实代码图反查故事清单。
why_en: Not a one-way PRD translator. It cross-checks story manifest against the real scanned graph, surfacing gaps between what docs.
limit_zh: 只认 code2flow.stories.json v2 清单和已扫描的图；PRD 需为 Markdown。
limit_en: Requires code2flow.stories.json v2 + scanned graph; PRD must be Markdown. Maps & reports drift only, no story generation beyond that.
title_en: PRD changes become a drift-checked story map
